verdict.rationale: Meilisearch markets fast, instant full-text search that finds results even from partial input, and documents React and Angular InstantSearch integrations for building responsive as-you-type interfaces. Hands-on users report search noticeably faster than Elasticsearch and on par with Algolia. One report of a 360ms response was attributed by a maintainer to waiting on OpenAI embeddings, so it does not concretely contradict keyword-search speed. Missing for 10: documented millisecond latency figures for keyword search (the only 'milliseconds' claim covers image search), explicit docs on prefix matching for per-keystroke querying, and independent latency benchmarks.
